results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_deleted = 0;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND is_deleted = 0;

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM products
WHERE is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id)
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.status = 'completed';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND region_id IS NULL;
SELECT sku FROM products WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND category = 'Hardware';

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS gross_invoiced_amount
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.invoice_date >= '2026-07-01'
  AND i.invoice_date < '2026-10-01'
  AND i.status <> 'void'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0;
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(-amount), 0) FROM payments WHERE amount < 0;

WITH completed_order_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.is_deleted = 0
    AND o.status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
)
SELECT
  customer_id,
  order_count
FROM completed_order_counts
WHERE order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM completed_order_counts);

SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - COALESCE(oi.discount_pct, 0) / 100.0)), 0) AS order_value
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.is_deleted = 0
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.order_date BETWEEN date('2026-10-15', '-89 day') AND '2026-10-15'
    GROUP BY o.order_id
) t;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS month,
       SUM(i.amount) AS total
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE i.status <> 'void'
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) IN ('2026-06', '2026-07', '2026-08')
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0.0
    ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 4)
  END
FROM invoices AS i
JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND i.status <> 'void'
  AND i.invoice_date >= '2026-04-01'
  AND i.invoice_date <= '2026-06-30';

WITH dates AS (
  SELECT '2026-06-30' AS order_date
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT d.order_date, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM dates AS d
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON o.order_date = d.order_date
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY d.order_date
ORDER BY d.order_date;

SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM customers
WHERE is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;

SELECT r.name AS region_name,
       ROUND(
         SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN -p.amount ELSE 0 END) /
         NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount > 0 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END), 0),
         4
       ) AS refund_ratio
FROM regions r
LEFT JOIN customers c
  ON c.region_id = r.region_id
 AND c.is_deleted = 0
LEFT JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 AND o.is_deleted = 0
 AND o.status = 'completed'
LEFT JOIN invoices i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN payments p
  ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
GROUP BY r.region_id, r.name
ORDER BY r.region_id;

WITH product_units AS (
    SELECT p.sku, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-07-01'
      AND o.order_date < '2026-10-01'
      AND o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.is_deleted = 0
      AND p.is_deleted = 0
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT sku, units,
           DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units DESC) AS rnk
    FROM product_units
)
SELECT sku, units
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk <= 3
ORDER BY units DESC, sku ASC;

SELECT c.customer_id, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.is_deleted = 0
  AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING MAX(o.order_date) < '2026-06-17'
ORDER BY last_order_date, c.customer_id;

SELECT CASE
  WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at_utc, '+05:30') = '2026-08' THEN amount END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
  ELSE ROUND(
    (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at_utc, '+05:30') = '2026-09' THEN amount END), 0)
     - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at_utc, '+05:30') = '2026-08' THEN amount END), 0))
    / COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at_utc, '+05:30') = '2026-08' THEN amount END), 0),
    4)
END
FROM payments;

SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  SUM(p.amount) AS net_amount
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 AND o.is_deleted = 0
JOIN invoices i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN payments p
  ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY c.customer_id
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.amount < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY net_amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC;
